questions.question_hindi:
भारत में दूरस्थ शिक्षा और मुक्त विश्वविद्यालयों के विकास के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. भारत में मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा की शुरुआत दिल्ली विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा 1962 में स्कूल ऑफ कॉरेस्पोंडेंस कोर्सेज एंड कंटिन्यूइंग एजुकेशन के माध्यम से की गई थी।
2. दूरस्थ शिक्षा परिषद (DEC) को भंग कर दिया गया था और 2013 से इसके सभी विनियामक कार्य DEB के तहत UGC द्वारा अपने हाथ में ले लिए गए थे।
3. शैक्षणिक सत्र 2017-18 के बाद यूजीसी (ODL) प्रथम और द्वितीय संशोधनों के तहत, आयोग स्टैंडअलोन संस्थानों के ओडीएल कार्यक्रमों को अप्रतिबंधित आजीवन स्वीकृति प्रदान करेगा।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the evolution of Distance Education and Open Universities in India:

1. Open and Distance Learning in India was introduced by Delhi University in 1962 through the School of Correspondence Courses and Continuing Education.
2. The Distance Education Council (DEC) was dissolved, and all regulatory functions were undertaken by the UGC under DEB with effect from 2013.
3. Vide UGC (ODL) First and Second Amendments after academic session 2017-18, the Commission shall grant unrestricted lifetime approval to Standalone Institutions offering ODL programmes.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because vide UGC (ODL) First and Second Amendments after academic session 2017-18, the Commission shall not accord any approval to the Open and Distance Learning programmes of Standalone Institutions.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि शैक्षणिक सत्र 2017-18 के बाद यूजीसी (ओडीएल) प्रथम और द्वितीय संशोधन के तहत, आयोग स्टैंडअलोन संस्थानों के मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों को कोई स्वीकृति प्रदान नहीं करेगा।
key_facts: However, vide UGC (ODL) First and Second Amendments after academic session 2017-18, the Commission shall not accord any approval to the Open and Distance Learning programmes of Standalone Institutions.

questions.question_hindi:
मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा प्रणाली के वैधानिक और विनियामक ढांचे के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. दूरस्थ शिक्षा परिषद (DEC) की स्थापना 1991 में इग्नू अधिनियम, 1985 की धारा 5(2) के साथ पठित धारा 16(7) के तहत की गई थी।
2. मई 2007 में, मई 2010 तक तीन वर्ष की अवधि के लिए UGC, AICTE और DEC के बीच एक समझौता ज्ञापन के माध्यम से एक संयुक्त समिति का गठन किया गया था।
3. शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने 25 फरवरी 2014 के अपने आदेश के तहत UGC को विश्वविद्यालयों/संबद्ध कॉलेजों में तकनीकी शिक्षा सहित ODL मोड में उच्च शिक्षा प्रणाली के लिए एक नियामक के रूप में कार्य करने का निर्देश दिया।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the statutory and regulatory framework of the Open and Distance Learning system:

1. The Distance Education Council (DEC) was established in 1991 under Section 16(7) read with Section 5(2) of the IGNOU Act, 1985.
2. In May 2007, a Joint Committee was formed through an MoU between UGC, AICTE, and DEC for a period of three years till May 2010.
3. The Ministry of Education vide its order dated 25th February, 2014 directed UGC to act as a regulator for higher education system in ODL mode, including for technical education in universities/affiliated colleges.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct according to the official UGC Distance Education Bureau document. Statement 1 describes the establishment of DEC in 1991 under Section 16(7) read with Section 5(2) of the IGNOU Act, 1985. Statement 2 describes the Joint Committee formed in May 2007. Statement 3 describes the Ministry of Education's order dated 25th February, 2014.
questions.explanation_hindi: यूजीसी दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो के आधिकारिक दस्तावेज़ के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। कथन 1 1991 में इग्नू अधिनियम, 1985 की धारा 16(7) व 5(2) के तहत डीईसी की स्थापना का विवरण देता है। कथन 2 मई 2007 में गठित संयुक्त समिति से संबंधित है। कथन 3 शिक्षा मंत्रालय के 25 फरवरी, 2014 के आदेश का सटीक वर्णन करता है।
key_facts: The Distance Education Council (DEC) was established in 1991 under Section 16(7) read with Section 5(2) of the IGNOU Act, 1985. As per clause (2) (a) of the statute 28, the DEC was responsible for the promotion and coordination of the Open and Distance Learning system in the Country. In May, 2007 a Joint Committee was formed by signing a MoU between UGC, AICTE and DEC for the period of three years till May, 2010. ... The Ministry of Education vide its order dated 25th February, 2014, has directed UGC to act as a regulator for higher education system in ODL mode, including for technical education in universities/affiliated colleges.

questions.question_hindi:
आंध्र प्रदेश में भारत के प्रथम मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय की उत्पत्ति और प्रारंभिक प्रक्षेपवक्र (trajectory) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर, एक मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय शुरू करने का प्रस्ताव दिसंबर 1970 से विचाराधीन था।
2. इस विश्वविद्यालय का उद्घाटन 26 अगस्त को नागार्जुनसागर में भारत के तत्कालीन राष्ट्रपति ज्ञानी जैल सिंह द्वारा किया गया था।
3. विश्वविद्यालय ने 1983 में जुबली हिल्स, हैदराबाद में अपने परिसर में स्थानांतरित होकर अपने 'कैंपस इयर्स' (द्वितीय चरण) की शुरुआत की।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the genesis and early trajectory of India's first Open University in Andhra Pradesh:

1. At the national level, the proposal to start an Open University had been under consideration since December 1970.
2. The University was inaugurated on 26th August at Nagarjunasagar by the then President of India, Gyani Zail Singh.
3. The University marked the beginning of its 'Campus Years' (Second Phase) by shifting to its own campus in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, in 1983.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: At the national level, the idea had been under consideration since December 1970, and it was inaugurated at Nagarjunasagar by the then President Gyani Zail Singh on 26th August. Statement 3 is incorrect because the Second Phase ('The Campus Years') begins in 1994 when the University shifted to its own campus in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad; in 1983, it was merely shifted to a Government building.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं: राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर, यह विचार दिसंबर 1970 से विचाराधीन था और इसका उद्घाटन तत्कालीन राष्ट्रपति ज्ञानी जैल सिंह द्वारा 26 अगस्त को नागार्जुनसागर में किया गया था। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि द्वितीय चरण ('द कैंपस इयर्स') 1994 में शुरू होता है जब विश्वविद्यालय जुबली हिल्स, हैदराबाद में अपने स्वयं के परिसर में स्थानांतरित हुआ; 1983 में इसे केवल एक सरकारी भवन में स्थानांतरित किया गया था।
key_facts: At the national level the idea of starting an Open University has been under consideration since December, 1970. ... The University was inaugurated by steps the then President of India Mr. Gyani Jail Singh on 26th August at Nagarjunasagar. ... The Campus Years of the Second Phase begins in 1994, with the shifting of University to its own campus in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad.

इन्दिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय अधिनियम, 1985 के तहत निर्दिष्ट धाराओं और प्राधिकरणों के संबंध में सूची I को सूची II से सुमेलित कीजिए:

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding the sections and authorities specified under The Indira Gandhi National Open University Act, 1985:

List I (Section)
A. Section 18
B. Section 19
C. Section 20
D. Section 22

questions.explanation_english: According to the Indira Gandhi National Open University Act, 1985: Section 18 corresponds to 'The Academic Council', Section 19 to 'The Planning Board', Section 20 to 'The Board of Recognition', and Section 22 to 'The Finance Committee'. Therefore, the matching code is A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4.
questions.explanation_hindi: इन्दिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय अधिनियम, 1985 के अनुसार: धारा 18 'द एकेडमिक काउंसिल' से, धारा 19 'द प्लानिंग बोर्ड' से, धारा 20 'द बोर्ड ऑफ रिकॉग्निशन' से तथा धारा 22 'द फाइनेंस कमेटी' से संबंधित है। अत: सही कूट A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4 है।

questions.question_hindi:
मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय पर 1974 के कार्य समूह (Working Group) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. भारत सरकार ने जवाहरलाल नेहरू विश्वविद्यालय के तत्कालीन कुलपति जी. पार्थसारथी के नेतृत्व में एक आठ सदस्यीय कार्य समूह नियुक्त किया।
2. कार्य समूह ने संसद के एक अधिनियम के माध्यम से यथाशीघ्र एक मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करने की सिफारिश की।
3. कार्य समूह ने विश्वविद्यालय के अधिकार क्षेत्र को प्रारंभ में केवल दिल्ली और शहरी महानगरीय क्षेत्रों तक सीमित रखने की सिफारिश की।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the 1974 Working Group on Open University:

1. The Government of India appointed an eight-member working group under the leadership of G. Parthasarathi, the then Vice-Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University.
2. The working group recommended establishing an open university through an act of Parliament as soon as possible.
3. The working group recommended limiting the university's jurisdiction initially to Delhi and urban metropolitan areas.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. In 1974, an eight-member working group was appointed under G. Parthasarathi, VC of JNU, and it recommended establishing an open university through an Act of Parliament. Statement 3 is incorrect because they stressed the importance of the university having jurisdiction over the entire country, not limiting it to urban areas.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। 1974 में जेएनयू के कुलपति जी. पार्थसारथी के नेतृत्व में आठ सदस्यीय कार्य समूह नियुक्त किया गया था, और इसने संसद के एक अधिनियम के माध्यम से एक मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करने की सिफारिश की थी। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि उन्होंने विश्वविद्यालय का अधिकार क्षेत्र पूरे देश में होने पर बल दिया था, न कि इसे शहरी क्षेत्रों तक सीमित रखने पर।
key_facts: Starting in 1974, the Government of India appointed an eight-member working group on the open university, the leading role was given to G. Parthasarathi, the then Vice-Chancellor of the Jawaharlal Nehru University. The working group recommended that an open university be established through an act of Parliament as soon as possible. They stressed the importance of the university having jurisdiction over the entire country

questions.question_hindi:
भारत में मुक्त एवं दूरस्थ शिक्षण (ODL) प्रणाली के विनियामक संक्रमण के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. भारत सरकार के उच्चतर शिक्षा विभाग ने 29.12.2012 को एक आदेश जारी किया जिसके द्वारा उच्च शिक्षा में दूरस्थ शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों (तकनीकी शिक्षा को छोड़कर) के विनियामक कार्य UGC को सौंपे गए, जबकि तकनीकी शिक्षा के लिए ODL मोड में विनियामक के रूप में कार्य करने का दायित्व AICTE का था।
2. UGC, AICTE और DEC की संयुक्त समिति ने 'रिकॉग्निशन ऑफ ओपन एंड डिस्टेंस लर्निंग (ODL) इंस्टीट्यूशन्स' हैंडबुक 2009 के रूप में दिशा-निर्देश विकसित किए थे।
3. पूर्ववर्ती DEC से UGC को विनियामक कार्य के हस्तांतरण के बाद, पहले से मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों/विश्वविद्यालयों को तीन शैक्षणिक वर्षों (2014-15 से 2016-17) की ब्लॉक अवधि के लिए मान्यता की निरंतरता प्रदान की गई थी।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the regulatory transition of the Open and Distance Learning (ODL) system in India:

1. The Department of Higher Education, Government of India, issued an order dated 29.12.2012 vesting regulatory functions of Distance Education programmes (excluding technical education) in higher education with the UGC, while AICTE was to act as regulator for technical education through ODL mode.
2. The Joint Committee of UGC, AICTE, and DEC formulated guidelines in the form of 'Recognition of Open and Distance Learning (ODL) Institutions' Handbook 2009.
3. Following the transfer of regulatory work from the erstwhile DEC to UGC, continuation of recognition was granted to already recognized Institutes/Universities for a block period of three academic years (2014-15 to 2016-17).

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because, after the transfer of regulatory functions from DEC to UGC, continuation of recognition was given to institutes/universities for only one year, i.e., 2014-15 (not three academic years), which already held institutional or programme-wise recognition.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि DEC से UGC को विनियामक कार्य के हस्तांतरण के बाद, पहले से मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों/विश्वविद्यालयों को केवल एक वर्ष यानी 2014-15 के लिए मान्यता की निरंतरता दी गई थी (न कि तीन शैक्षणिक वर्षों के लिए)।
key_facts: After the transfer of regulatory work from the erstwhile DEC to UGC, the continuation of recognition was given to Institutes/Universities for one year i.e. 2014-15, which were already having recognition under institutional recognition/programme wise recognition.

questions.question_hindi: दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो (DEB - UGC) के अनुसार, नियमित या मुक्त एवं दूरस्थ शिक्षा प्रणालियों के माध्यम से शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाले 'उच्चतर शैक्षणिक संस्थान' (Higher Educational Institution) को विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग अधिनियम, 1956 की किन धाराओं के अंतर्गत आने वाले विश्वविद्यालय एवं मानित विश्वविद्यालय के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: According to the Distance Education Bureau (DEB - UGC), a 'Higher Educational Institution' offering education through regular or Open and Distance Learning systems is defined as a university and an institution deemed to be a university covered under which sections of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956?
questions.explanation_english: As stated by the Distance Education Bureau, “Higher Educational Institution” means a university covered under clause (f) of section 2 and an institution deemed to be a university covered under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956.
questions.explanation_hindi: दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो के अनुसार, "उच्चतर शैक्षणिक संस्थान" (Higher Educational Institution) का अर्थ विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 2 के खंड (f) के अंतर्गत आने वाला एक विश्वविद्यालय और धारा 3 के अंतर्गत आने वाला मानित विश्वविद्यालय (deemed to be a university) संस्थान है।
key_facts: “Higher Educational Institution” means a university covered under clause (f) of section 2 and an institution deemed to be a university covered under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956

2. सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने उल्लेख किया कि न तो शासी कानून और न ही विशेष सेवा नियम यह अनिवार्य करते हैं कि मान्यता प्राप्त डिग्री अनिवार्य रूप से एक भौतिक, नियमित कक्षा पाठ्यक्रम से ही प्राप्त की जानी चाहिए।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Supreme Court judgment on the validity of Open University qualifications and distance education degrees:

1. A Supreme Court bench comprising Justice Ujjal Bhuyan and Justice Manoj Misra held that government orders modifying or invalidating open university foundation courses cannot be applied retrospectively to deny promotion benefits.
2. The Supreme Court noted that neither the governing statute nor special service rules mandate that a recognized degree must strictly come from a physical, regular classroom course.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. The Supreme Court bench comprising Justice Ujjal Bhuyan and Justice Manoj Misra held that government orders modifying or invalidating open university foundation courses and distance education degrees cannot be applied retrospectively to deny promotion benefits. Furthermore, the bench pointed out that neither the law nor special service rules mandate that a recognized degree must strictly come from a physical, regular classroom course.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। न्यायमूर्ति उज्ज्वल भुइयां और न्यायमूर्ति मनोज मिश्रा की सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की पीठ ने फैसला सुनाया कि खुले विश्वविद्यालय के फाउंडेशन पाठ्यक्रमों और दूरस्थ शिक्षा डिग्रियों को संशोधित या अमान्य करने वाले सरकारी आदेशों को उन कर्मचारियों पर पूर्वव्यापी प्रभाव से लागू नहीं किया जा सकता, जिन्होंने तत्कालीन नियमों के तहत योग्यता हासिल की थी। इसके अलावा, पीठ ने इंगित किया कि न तो कानून और न ही विशेष सेवा नियम यह अनिवार्य करते हैं कि एक मान्यता प्राप्त डिग्री भौतिक, नियमित कक्षा पाठ्यक्रम से ही आनी चाहिए।
key_facts: A Supreme Court bench comprising Justice Ujjal Bhuyan and Justice Manoj Misra has held that government orders modifying or invalidating open university foundation courses and distance education degrees cannot be applied retrospectively to deny promotion benefits to employees who acquired their qualifications under the prevailing norms.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the legal dispute on open university qualification rules decided by the Supreme Court:

1. The 1985 government order treating open university foundation courses as equivalent to the higher secondary (+2) stream remained active for over 24 years.
2. The state rejected the promotion bid on the grounds that the open university qualification did not fit the traditional 10+2+3 formal education pattern.
3. The Supreme Court held that administrative instructions altering eligibility conditions operate retrospectively to dismantle accrued promotional rights.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the Supreme Court firmly ruled that the 2017 administrative order can only operate prospectively, holding that administrative uncertainty cannot be allowed to destroy accrued rights built over decades and cannot apply retrospectively to deny promotions.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने दृढ़ता से स्थापित किया कि 2017 का प्रशासनिक आदेश केवल भविष्योन्मुखी (prospectively) रूप से संचालित हो सकता है, और प्रशासनिक अनिश्चितता को दशकों में बने अधिकारों को नष्ट करने की अनुमति नहीं दी जा सकती तथा इसे पूर्वव्यापी रूप से लागू नहीं किया जा सकता।
key_facts: The Supreme Court firmly established that this 2017 order can only operate prospectively. The bench noted that administrative instructions altering eligibility conditions must be construed reasonably to avoid punishing citizens who strictly followed the rules that governed them at the relevant time.

questions.explanation_hindi: अधिनियम के विस्तृत शीर्षक (Long Title) के अनुसार, यह 'देश के शैक्षिक स्वरूप में मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय और दूरस्थ शिक्षा प्रणालियों की शुरुआत और संवर्धन तथा ऐसी प्रणालियों में मानकों के समन्वय एवं निर्धारण के लिए राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर एक मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना और निगमन करने के लिए एक अधिनियम' है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Lord Geoffrey Crowther, the first Chancellor of the UK Open University, famously proclaimed at its inaugural ceremony that the university's purpose was to be open in four key aspects. Which of the following is NOT one of those four aspects?
questions.explanation_english: According to the text, Lord Geoffrey Crowther proclaimed the UK Open University's purpose of being 'open as to people, open as to places, open as to methods and open as to ideas'. 'Open as to finances' is not one of the four aspects.
questions.explanation_hindi: पाठ के अनुसार, लॉर्ड जेफ्री क्राउदर ने यूके ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी के उद्देश्य की घोषणा करते हुए कहा था कि यह 'लोगों के संबंध में खुला, स्थानों के संबंध में खुला, पद्धतियों के संबंध में खुला और विचारों के संबंध में खुला' (open as to people, open as to places, open as to methods and open as to ideas) होगा। 'वित्त के संबंध में खुला' इसमें शामिल नहीं है।
key_facts: Lord Geoffrey Crowther, captured the public imagination at the UKOU’s inaugural ceremony when he proclaimed its purpose of being “open as to people, open as to places, open as to methods and open as to ideas” (Crowther, 1969, pp. 1-2).

questions.question_hindi:

2. 1990 के दशक का 'आयरन ट्रायंगल' (iron triangle) का सिद्धांत दूरस्थ शिक्षा में पहुंच (access), लागत (cost) और गुणवत्ता (quality) के तीन विषयों का विश्लेषण करता है।
3. वाल्टर पेरी और उनके सहयोगियों ने 1960 के दशक के अंत में यूके ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी के लिए अग्रणी शिक्षण और अधिगम प्रणाली विकसित की।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the global evolution and concepts of Open Universities:

1. By the second decade of the 21st century, there were some 50 open universities globally, with Commonwealth countries alone counting 27 of them.
2. The concept of the 'iron triangle' from the 1990s explores the three topics of access, cost, and quality in distance education.
3. Walter Perry and colleagues developed the pioneering teaching and learning system for the UK Open University in the late 1960s.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct based on John S. Daniel's article. The text notes that there were some 50 OUs, with 50+ Commonwealth countries counting 27 of them (Mishra, 2017); the 'iron triangle' from the 1990s explores access, cost, and quality; and the teaching and learning system was developed for the UKOU by Walter Perry and colleagues in the 1960s.
questions.explanation_hindi: जॉन एस. डैनियल के लेख के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। पाठ में उल्लेख है कि लगभग 50 मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय थे, जिनमें 50 से अधिक राष्ट्रमंडल देशों में 27 शामिल हैं; 1990 के दशक का 'आयरन ट्रायंगल' पहुंच, लागत और गुणवत्ता की पड़ताल करता है; और 1960 के दशक में वाल्टर पेरी और सहयोगियों द्वारा यूकेओयू के लिए शिक्षण प्रणाली विकसित की गई थी।
key_facts: Next, we will revisit the concept of the iron triangle from the 1990s, which explores the three topics access, cost, and quality... By then there were some 50 open universities (OUs). The 50+ Commonwealth countries alone count 27 of them (Mishra, 2017)... It also recalls with admiration the teaching and learning system developed for the UKOU by Walter Perry and colleagues in the 1960s.

questions.explanation_english: Prasad (2018) made the distinction between the dharma (social purposes) and the karma (actual practice) of distance learning in India. Walter Perry and colleagues developed the UKOU teaching and learning system. Lord Geoffrey Crowther proclaimed the UKOU's open purposes at the inaugural ceremony. The first chancellor of the UK Open University (UKOU), Lord Geoffrey Crowther, captured the public imagination at the UKOU’s inaugural ceremony... A later section of the paper recalls the conclusions of a roundtable of OU vice-chancellors held in the margins of the ICDE World Conference on Online Learning in October 2017 (Daniel & Tait, 2017).

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the institutional critique and administrative reflections on Open and Dual Mode universities:

1. According to M. A. Sikandar, Open Distance Learning (ODL) offered by Open Universities and Dual mode Universities in India is at crossroads because of multiple control and regulation by several regulatory bodies of the Central Government.
2. In a 1972 critique of the UK Open University by Irving J. Spitzberg, Jr. (Institute of Current World Affairs), Study Centers were characterized as 'The Social Infrastructure of the Open University'.
3. John S. Daniel highlights that a distinction made in the 1970s between independent and interactive learning activities helps examine how the iron triangle applies to distance education.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All statements 1, 2, and 3 are correct. Statement 1 is verified directly from M. A. Sikandar's paper ('Today, Open Distance Learning (ODL) offered by the Open Universities and Dual mode Universities in India is at cross roads because of multiple control and regulation by several regulatory bodies of the Central Government'). Statement 2 is verified from Irving J. Spitzberg's paper Table of Contents ('III. STUDY CENTERS THE SOCIAL INFRA STRUCTURE OF THE OPEN UNIVERSITY'). Statement 3 is verified from John S. Daniel's abstract ('A distinction made in the 1970s between independent and interactive learning activities helps us pursue this question further').
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1, 2 और 3 तीनों सही हैं। कथन 1 एम. ए. सिकंदर के शोध पत्र से सत्यापित है ('Today, Open Distance Learning (ODL)... is at cross roads because of multiple control and regulation...')। कथन 2 इरविंग जे. स्पिट्जबर्ग जूनियर के रिपोर्ट के अनुक्रम से सत्यापित है ('III. STUDY CENTERS THE SOCIAL INFRA STRUCTURE OF THE OPEN UNIVERSITY')। कथन 3 जॉन एस. डैनियल के शोध पत्र से सत्यापित है ('A distinction made in the 1970s between independent and interactive learning activities helps us pursue this question further')।
key_facts: Today, Open Distance Learning (ODL) offered by the Open Universities and Dual mode Universities in India is at cross roads because of multiple control and regulation by several regulatory bodies of the Central Government. ... I I I. STUDY CENTERS THE SOCIAL INFRA STRUCTURE OF THE OPEN UNIVERSITY ... A distinction made in the 1970s between independent and interactive learning activities helps us pursue this question further.

questions.question_hindi:

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the emergence and history of Open and Distance Learning (ODL) in India:

1. In the early decades after independence, the University of Delhi and the University of Madras were among the major institutions that launched correspondence courses.
2. Andhra Pradesh Open University, established in 1982, was India’s first dedicated open university.
3. The University Education Commission (1948–49), which emphasized democratizing higher education, was chaired by Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct. In the 1960s and 1970s, the University of Delhi and University of Madras launched correspondence courses sending printed study materials by post. In 1982, Andhra Pradesh Open University (later renamed Dr BR Ambedkar Open University) was established as India’s first dedicated open university. The University Education Commission (1948–49) was chaired by Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.

1. UPSC CSE पात्रता के लिए किसी मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय से स्नातक की डिग्री अनिवार्य है, जिससे अध्ययन के माध्यम के बजाय डिग्री की मान्यता निर्णायक आधार बन जाती है।
2. एक मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय से अर्जित डिग्री UPSC CSE के लिए पात्र है, बशर्ते विश्वविद्यालय UGC या उसके दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो (DEB) द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त हो।
3. आधिकारिक UPSC परिपत्र में निर्दिष्ट किया गया है कि आवेदक के पास भारत में केंद्रीय या राज्य विधानमंडल के एक अधिनियम द्वारा निगमित विश्वविद्यालय से डिग्री होनी चाहिए।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the eligibility of degrees obtained through Open Universities and distance education for the UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE):

1. UPSC CSE eligibility requires a bachelor’s degree from a recognised university, making degree recognition rather than the mode of study the decisive baseline criterion.
2. A degree earned through an open university is eligible for UPSC CSE provided the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB).
3. The official UPSC circular specifies that an applicant must possess a degree from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct according to the context. Statement 1 is verified by: 'The candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree from a recognised university. Recognition is the baseline criterion, not the mode of study.' Statement 2 is verified by: 'A degree earned through distance education, open university, or private institution is eligible for UPSC CSE if the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB).' Statement 3 is verified by: 'The official UPSC circular, published in the Gazette of India each year, lists the specific educational qualifications for interested candidates. It states that an applicant must possess a degree from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India.'
questions.explanation_hindi: संदर्भ के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। कथन 1 की पुष्टि होती है: 'The candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree from a recognised university. Recognition is the baseline criterion, not the mode of study.' कथन 2 की पुष्टि होती है: 'A degree earned through distance education, open university, or private institution is eligible for UPSC CSE if the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB).' कथन 3 की पुष्टि होती है: 'It states that an applicant must possess a degree from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India.'
key_facts: A degree earned through distance education, open university, or private institution is eligible for UPSC CSE if the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB).

questions.question_hindi:
मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय पात्रता से जुड़े अवधारणाओं, प्रकाशनों और नियामक शब्दों के संबंध में सूची I को सूची II से सुमेलित कीजिए:

सूची I (प्रासंगिक विशेषता / नियामक शब्द)
A. UPSC अधिसूचनाओं में बार-बार उल्लिखित आधारभूत और निर्णायक मानदंड
B. UGC के अधीन विशिष्ट ब्यूरो जो दूरस्थ शिक्षा मान्यता की देखरेख करता है
C. वैधानिक प्रकाशन जिसमें वार्षिक UPSC शैक्षणिक योग्यता परिपत्र प्रकाशित होते हैं
D. सरकारी भर्ती के लिए नियमित डिग्रियों के साथ ODL डिग्रियों को दिया गया समान दर्जा

सूची II (संबंधित निकाय / प्रावधान)
1. दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो (DEB)
2. भारत का राजपत्र (Gazette of India)
3. 'मान्यता प्राप्त' (Recognised) विश्वविद्यालय
4. UGC और DEB द्वारा समकक्षता

नीचे दिए गए कूट का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding concepts, publications, and regulatory terms associated with Open University eligibility:

List I (Contextual Feature / Regulatory Term)
A. Baseline and decisive criterion appearing repeatedly in UPSC notifications
B. Specialized bureau under UGC overseeing distance education recognition
C. Statutory publication carrying annual UPSC educational qualification circulars
D. Equal status accorded to ODL degrees alongside regular degrees for government recruitment

List II (Corresponding Entity / Provision)
1. Distance Education Bureau (DEB)
2. Gazette of India
3. 'Recognised' university
4. Equivalence by UGC and DEB

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
questions.explanation_english: According to the provided texts: A matches with 3 ('The word recognised appears repeatedly in UPSC notifications and is the decisive criterion for eligibility'); B matches with 1 ('Distance Education Bureau (DEB)'); C matches with 2 ('The official UPSC circular, published in the Gazette of India each year, lists the specific educational qualifications...'); D matches with 4 ('Formal and non-formal degrees through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) systems for purposes of government employment and higher studies are treated exactly as equivalent to regular degrees by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the Distance Education Bureau (DEB)'). Thus, the correct sequence is A-3, B-1, C-2, D-4.
questions.explanation_hindi: प्रदत्त संदर्भ के अनुसार: A का मिलान 3 से होता है ('The word recognised appears repeatedly in UPSC notifications and is the decisive criterion for eligibility'); B का मिलान 1 से होता है ('Distance Education Bureau (DEB)'); C का मिलान 2 से होता है ('The official UPSC circular, published in the Gazette of India each year...'); D का मिलान 4 से होता है ('treated exactly as equivalent to regular degrees by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the Distance Education Bureau (DEB)')। अतः सही क्रम A-3, B-1, C-2, D-4 है।
key_facts: The word recognised appears repeatedly in UPSC notifications and is the decisive criterion for eligibility. The mode of study or whether the degree came from a distance, open, or private venue does not automatically disqualify a candidate, provided the university is recognised by the appropriate statutory bodies.

questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs regarding open university credentials, recognition frameworks, and government recruitment rules is NOT correctly matched?

Equivalence of ODL degrees to regular degrees for employment — Treated as equivalent by UGC and DEB
Mode of study rule for distance/open university candidates — Automatically disqualifies candidates from appearing in competitive examinations

questions.question_hindi:
मुक्त एवं दूरस्थ शिक्षण (ODL) प्रमाणपत्रों की संस्थागत स्वीकृति और समकक्षता के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. मुक्त एवं दूरस्थ शिक्षण (ODL) प्रणालियों के माध्यम से प्राप्त औपचारिक और गैर-औपचारिक डिग्रियों को UGC और DEB द्वारा सरकारी रोजगार और उच्च अध्ययन के लिए नियमित डिग्रियों के बिल्कुल समकक्ष माना जाता है।
2. एक दूरस्थ या मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय की डिग्री को स्वतः खारिज कर दिया जाता है जब तक कि आवेदक पारंपरिक कॉलेज उत्सवों में भाग लेने और भौतिक उपस्थिति का दस्तावेजीकरण न करे।
3. दूरस्थ या मुक्त माध्यमों से प्रदान की गई डिग्रियां UPSC के तहत पात्र हैं, बशर्ते संस्थान UGC/DEB मान्यता पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के अंतर्गत हो और विशिष्ट कार्यक्रम मान्यता प्राप्त पाठ्यक्रमों के रूप में सूचीबद्ध हों।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the institutional acceptance and equivalence of Open and Distance Learning (ODL) credentials:

1. Formal and non-formal degrees earned through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) systems are treated exactly as equivalent to regular degrees by UGC and DEB for government employment and higher studies.
2. A distance or open university credential is automatically rejected unless the applicant documents physical attendance and participation in traditional college festivals.
3. Degrees awarded through distance or open modes are eligible under UPSC provided the institution is within the UGC/DEB recognition ecosystem and the specific programs are listed as recognized courses.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because the absence of physical attendance or college festivals is an outdated societal perception, not a government or UPSC disqualification criterion ('Since IGNOU lacks the required days of physical attendance, college festivals, and many other things deemed necessary by the public, they assume the government will not recognize the degree... Formal and non-formal degrees through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) systems for purposes of government employment and higher studies are treated exactly as equivalent to regular degrees by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the Distance Education Bureau (DEB)').
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 3 सही हैं। कथन 2 गलत है क्योंकि शारीरिक उपस्थिति या कॉलेज उत्सवों की अनुपस्थिति समाज की एक पुरानी धारणा है, न कि सरकार या UPSC की अयोग्यता का नियम ('Formal and non-formal degrees through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) systems for purposes of government employment and higher studies are treated exactly as equivalent to regular degrees by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the Distance Education Bureau (DEB)')। अतः केवल 1 और 3 सही हैं।
key_facts: Formal and non-formal degrees through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) systems for purposes of government employment and higher studies are treated exactly as equivalent to regular degrees by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the Distance Education Bureau (DEB).

questions.question_hindi: दूरस्थ और मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षा को नियंत्रित करने वाले नियामक दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार, विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) के अधीन कार्यरत कौन-सा ब्यूरो दूरस्थ कार्यक्रमों के लिए मान्यता प्रणाली बनाए रखता है?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: According to the regulatory guidelines governing distance and open university education, which bureau functioning under the University Grants Commission (UGC) maintains the recognition ecosystem for distance programs?
questions.explanation_english: The regulatory entity operating under UGC specifically responsible for distance education programs is the Distance Education Bureau (DEB).
questions.explanation_hindi: दूरस्थ शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों के लिए विशेष रूप से जिम्मेदार UGC के अधीन कार्यरत नियामक निकाय दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो (DEB) है।
key_facts: A degree earned through distance education, open university, or private institution is eligible for UPSC CSE if the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB).

questions.question_hindi:
भारत में मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा (ODL) विनियामक ढांचे के विकास से संबंधित प्रमुख मील के पत्थरों और आदेशों के संदर्भ में सूची I को सूची II से सुमेलित कीजिए:

सूची I (मील का पत्थर / विनियामक आदेश)
A. इग्नू अधिनियम के तहत दूरस्थ शिक्षा परिषद (DEC) की स्थापना
B. UGC, AICTE और DEC के बीच समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर करके संयुक्त समिति का गठन
C. दूरस्थ शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों (तकनीकी शिक्षा को छोड़कर) के विनियामक कार्यों को UGC में निहित करने वाला आदेश
D. विश्वविद्यालयों में तकनीकी शिक्षा सहित ODL प्रणाली के नियामक के रूप में कार्य करने हेतु UGC को निर्देशित करने वाला आदेश

सूची II (वर्ष / तिथि)
1. 1991
2. मई, 2007
3. 29.12.2012
4. 25 फरवरी, 2014

नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग कर सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding key milestones and orders in the evolution of the Open and Distance Learning (ODL) regulatory framework in India:

List I (Milestone / Regulatory Order)
A. Establishment of Distance Education Council (DEC) under the IGNOU Act
B. Formation of Joint Committee by signing of MoU between UGC, AICTE, and DEC
C. Order vesting regulatory functions of distance education (excluding technical education) with UGC
D. Order directing UGC to act as regulator for ODL mode including technical education in universities

List II (Year / Date)
1. 1991
2. May, 2007
3. 29.12.2012
4. 25th February, 2014

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
questions.explanation_english: According to the official Distance Education Bureau records: The Distance Education Council (DEC) was established in 1991 under the IGNOU Act, 1985. In May 2007, a Joint Committee was formed by signing an MoU between UGC, AICTE, and DEC. On 29.12.2012, an order vested regulatory functions of distance education (excluding technical education) in the UGC. On 25th February, 2014, the Ministry of Education directed UGC to act as a regulator for the higher education system in ODL mode including technical education.
questions.explanation_hindi: दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो के आधिकारिक विवरण के अनुसार: दूरस्थ शिक्षा परिषद (DEC) की स्थापना 1991 में इग्नू अधिनियम, 1985 के तहत की गई थी। मई 2007 में, UGC, AICTE और DEC के बीच समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर करके एक संयुक्त समिति का गठन किया गया था। 29.12.2012 के आदेश द्वारा दूरस्थ शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों (तकनीकी शिक्षा को छोड़कर) के विनियामक कार्य UGC को सौंपे गए थे। 25 फरवरी, 2014 को शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने UGC को विश्वविद्यालयों में तकनीकी शिक्षा सहित ODL मोड में उच्च शिक्षा नियामक के रूप में कार्य करने का निर्देश दिया था।
key_facts: The Distance Education Council (DEC) was established in 1991 under Section 16(7) read with Section 5(2) of the IGNOU Act, 1985. As per clause (2) (a) of the statute 28, the DEC was responsible for the promotion and coordination of the Open and Distance Learning system in the Country. In May, 2007 a Joint Committee was formed by signing a MoU between UGC, AICTE and DEC for the period of three years till May, 2010. The Joint Committee developed guidelines in the form of ‘Recognition of Open and Distance Learning (ODL) Institutions’ Handbook 2009. Thereafter, in pursuance of the directions issued by the Ministry of Education, the Department of Higher Education, Government of India issued order dated 29.12.2012, thereby the regulatory functions with regard to Distance Education programmes (excluding technical education) in higher education were vested with the University Grants Commission and for technical education, the AICTE act as a regulator through ODL mode. The Distance Education Council, which was the erstwhile regulator of Distance Education programmes, was dissolved and all regulatory functions were undertaken by the UGC under DEB (Distance Education Bureau) with effect from 2013. The Ministry of Education vide its order dated 25th February, 2014, has directed UGC to act as a regulator for higher education system in ODL mode, including for technical education in universities/affiliated colleges.

questions.question_hindi:
मुक्त विश्वविद्यालयों और उच्चतर शिक्षण संस्थानों के लिए क्रेडिट, शैक्षणिक कार्यक्रमों और स्व-अधिगम सामग्री (SLM) को नियंत्रित करने वाले UGC विनियमों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. एक मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय को मुक्त और दूरस्थ मोड में कार्यक्रमों को कुल क्रेडिट और न्यूनतम अवधि के साथ पेश करना होगा जो केंद्रीय और/या राज्य विश्वविद्यालयों द्वारा पारंपरिक मोड में संबंधित कार्यक्रमों के समान रखी गई हो।
2. ऑनलाइन मोड में कार्यक्रम पेश करने के लिए, कुल क्रेडिट और न्यूनतम अवधि मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षण मोड में संबंधित कार्यक्रम के समान होगी।
3. कम से कम 60 प्रतिशत स्व-अधिगम सामग्री उच्च शिक्षण संस्थान के आंतरिक संकाय द्वारा विकसित की जानी चाहिए।
4. एक उच्चतर शिक्षण संस्थान अपनी स्व-अधिगम सामग्री तैयार करने से पहले ODL कार्यक्रम शुरू कर सकता है, बशर्ते कार्यक्रम परियोजना रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत कर दी गई हो।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding UGC regulations governing Credits, Academic Programmes, and Self Learning Material (SLM) for Open Universities and Higher Educational Institutions:

1. An Open University must offer programmes in Open and Distance mode with total credits and minimum duration kept the same as that of corresponding programmes in conventional mode by Central and/or State Universities.
2. For offering programmes in Online mode, the total credits and minimum duration shall be the same as that of the corresponding programme in Open and Distance Learning mode.
3. At least 60 per cent of Self Learning Materials must be developed by the in-house faculty of the Higher Educational Institution.
4. A Higher Educational Institution can launch an ODL programme before preparing its Self Learning Material, provided the Programme Project Report has been submitted.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1, 2, and 3 are correct according to the UGC Compendium Regulations. Statement 4 is incorrect because the regulations explicitly specify: 'Provided further that no programme in Open and Distance Learning mode shall be launched by a Higher Educational Institution unless it has prepared the Self Learning Material taking into consideration the above factors.'
questions.explanation_hindi: UGC विनियमों के अनुसार कथन 1, 2 और 3 सही हैं। कथन 4 गलत है क्योंकि नियमों में स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया है: 'बशर्ते कि किसी भी उच्चतर शिक्षण संस्थान द्वारा मुक्त एवं दूरस्थ शिक्षण मोड में कोई कार्यक्रम तब तक शुरू नहीं किया जाएगा जब तक कि उसने उपरोक्त कारकों को ध्यान में रखते हुए स्व-अधिगम सामग्री तैयार न कर ली हो।'
key_facts: An Open University shall offer programmes in Open and Distance mode with total credits and minimum duration for programmes kept same as that of corresponding programmes in conventional mode by the Central and/or State Universities and for offering programmes in Online mode, total credits and minimum duration for programme shall be the same as that of corresponding programme in Open and Distance Learning mode. ... At least 60 per cent. of Self Learning Materials shall be developed by the in- house faculty of the Higher Educational Institution and the remaining per cent. of the materials can be sourced from available resources such as other Higher Educational Institutions, Open Educational Resources (OER), and SWAYAM, duly approved by the statutory authorities of the Higher Educational Institution; ... Provided further that no programme in Open and Distance Learning mode shall be launched by a Higher Educational Institution unless it has prepared the Self Learning Material taking into consideration the above factors.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the regulatory transition of Open and Distance Learning (ODL) and institutional recognitions under the University Grants Commission:

1. For universities, UGC accorded recognition for offering distance mode programmes for two academic years, namely 2016-17 and 2017-18, based on recommendations of Expert Committees.
2. Vide UGC (ODL) First and Second Amendments after academic session 2017-18, the Commission shall not accord any approval to the Open and Distance Learning programmes of Standalone Institutions.
3. In the history of Indian distance education, Punjabi University and the University of Rajasthan started correspondence courses in 1968, followed by Meerut and Mysore University in 1969.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct as per the official UGC Distance Education Bureau ODL portal history and regulations. Universities were granted recognition for 2016-17 and 2017-18; standalone institutions were barred from receiving ODL approvals after 2017-18; and correspondence courses were launched by Punjabi University & Rajasthan University in 1968, and Meerut & Mysore Universities in 1969.
questions.explanation_hindi: UGC दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो ODL पोर्टल के विवरण के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। विश्वविद्यालयों को 2016-17 और 2017-18 के लिए मान्यता दी गई थी; 2017-18 के बाद स्टैंडअलोन संस्थानों को ODL कार्यक्रमों की मंजूरी नहीं दी गई; और पत्राचार पाठ्यक्रम 1968 में पंजाबी विश्वविद्यालय और राजस्थान विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा तथा 1969 में मेरठ और मैसूर विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा शुरू किए गए थे।
key_facts: Subsequently in 1968, Correspondence Courses were started by Punjabi University and University of Rajasthan. Meerut and Mysore University started these courses in 1969. ... In the case of universities, the recognition was accorded for two academic years i.e. for 2016-17 and 2017-18. However, vide UGC (ODL) First and Second Amendments after academic session 2017-18, the Commission shall not accord any approval to the Open and Distance Learning programmes of Standalone Institutions.

questions.question_hindi:
दूरस्थ शिक्षा परिषद (DEC) की वैधानिक नींव और विनियामक निरंतरता आदेशों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. दूरस्थ शिक्षा परिषद (DEC) की स्थापना इग्नू अधिनियम, 1985 की धारा 5(2) के साथ पठित धारा 16(7) के तहत की गई थी।
2. परिनियम 28 के खंड (2) (a) के अनुसार, DEC देश में मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा प्रणाली के संवर्धन और समन्वय के लिए जिम्मेदार थी।
3. ओडीएल विनियमों के अभाव में, विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग ने उन संस्थानों के संबंध में 2015-16 के दौरान मान्यता जारी रखने का निर्णय लिया, जिन्हें ओडीएल कार्यक्रम संचालित करने के लिए 2014-15 के दौरान मान्यता दी गई थी।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the statutory foundation of the Distance Education Council (DEC) and regulatory continuation orders:

1. The Distance Education Council (DEC) was established under Section 16(7) read with Section 5(2) of the IGNOU Act, 1985.
2. Under clause (2) (a) of Statute 28, the DEC was responsible for the promotion and coordination of the Open and Distance Learning system in the Country.
3. In the absence of ODL Regulations, the University Grants Commission decided to continue recognition during 2015-16 in respect of those institutions which were recognized during 2014-15 to offer ODL programmes.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct based on the Distance Education Bureau record: DEC was established under Section 16(7) read with Section 5(2) of the IGNOU Act, 1985; under clause (2) (a) of Statute 28, it was tasked with promotion and coordination of ODL in the country; and subsequently, in the absence of ODL Regulations, the Commission continued recognition during 2015-16 for institutions recognized during 2014-15.
questions.explanation_hindi: दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो के रिकॉर्ड के आधार पर तीनों कथन सही हैं: DEC की स्थापना इग्नू अधिनियम, 1985 की धारा 5(2) के साथ पठित धारा 16(7) के तहत की गई थी; परिनियम 28 के खंड (2) (a) के अनुसार, यह देश में ओडीएल प्रणाली के संवर्धन और समन्वय के लिए जिम्मेदार थी; और बाद में, ओडीएल विनियमों के अभाव में, आयोग ने 2014-15 के दौरान मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों के लिए 2015-16 के दौरान मान्यता जारी रखने का निर्णय लिया।
key_facts: The Distance Education Council (DEC) was established in 1991 under Section 16(7) read with Section 5(2) of the IGNOU Act, 1985. As per clause (2) (a) of the statute 28, the DEC was responsible for the promotion and coordination of the Open and Distance Learning system in the Country. In May, 2007 a Joint Committee was formed by signing a MoU between UGC, AICTE and DEC for the period of three years till May, 2010. ... Subsequently, in the absence of ODL Regulations, Commission decided to continue the recognition during 2015-16 in respect of those institutions which were recognized during 2014-15 to offer ODL programmes.

questions.question_hindi:

1. भारत में मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा की शुरुआत 1962 में दिल्ली विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा स्कूल ऑफ कॉरेस्पोंडेंस कोर्सेज एंड कंटिन्यूइंग एजुकेशन के माध्यम से की गई थी।
2. डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय, हैदराबाद की स्थापना 1982 में आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य द्वारा की गई थी।
3. डीईबी दिशानिर्देशों के तहत परिभाषित 'उच्चतर शैक्षिक संस्थान' में विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 2 के खंड (f) के तहत आने वाला विश्वविद्यालय और धारा 3 के तहत आने वाला मानित विश्वविद्यालय शामिल है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the inception of Open and Distance Learning (ODL) and the definition of 'Higher Educational Institution':

1. Open and Distance Learning in India was introduced by Delhi University in 1962 through the School of Correspondence Courses and Continuing Education.
2. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Open University, Hyderabad was established in 1982 by the State of Andhra Pradesh.
3. As defined under DEB guidelines, a 'Higher Educational Institution' includes a university covered under clause (f) of section 2 and an institution deemed to be a university covered under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct as per the official Distance Education Bureau portal: ODL in India was introduced by Delhi University in 1962 through the School of Correspondence Courses and Continuing Education; Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Open University was established in 1982 by the State of Andhra Pradesh; and a Higher Educational Institution is statutory defined under clause (f) of Section 2 and Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
questions.explanation_hindi: दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो के आधिकारिक पोर्टल के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं: भारत में ओडीएल की शुरुआत 1962 में दिल्ली विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा स्कूल ऑफ कॉरेस्पोंडेंस कोर्सेज एंड कंटिन्यूइंग एजुकेशन के माध्यम से की गई थी; डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना 1982 में आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य द्वारा की गई थी; और उच्चतर शैक्षिक संस्थान को यूजीसी अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 2 के खंड (f) और धारा 3 के तहत परिभाषित किया गया है।
key_facts: Open and Distance Learning in India was introduced by Delhi University in 1962 through the School of Correspondence Courses and Continuing Education to enable those, who had the inclination and aptitude to acquire further knowledge and improve their professional competence. Subsequently in 1968, Correspondence Courses were started by Punjabi University and University of Rajasthan. Meerut and Mysore University started these courses in 1969. In the eighties, the distance education system expanded further. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Open University, Hyderabad was established in 1982 by the State of Andhra Pradesh. ... “Higher Educational Institution” means a university covered under clause (f) of section 2 and an institution deemed to be a university covered under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956, which is imparting by means of conducting regular classes or through Open and Distance Learning systems, higher education or research therein.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: According to the historical trajectory of India's first Open University: (1) During the Early Years (1982 to 1993), the university functioned from rented accommodation in Somajiguda, and in 1994 it shifted to its own campus in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad. (2) The university was inaugurated on 26th August at Nagarjunasagar by the then President of India, Mr. Gyani Zail Singh. भारत सरकार द्वारा गठित 1974 के मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय कार्य समूह (Working Group on Open University) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. यह कार्य समूह एक आठ सदस्यीय निकाय था, जिसमें प्रमुख भूमिका जवाहरलाल नेहरू विश्वविद्यालय के तत्कालीन कुलपति जी. पार्थसारथी को सौंपी गई थी।
2. कार्य समूह ने सिफारिश की थी कि प्रायोगिक क्रियान्वयन की सुविधा के लिए राष्ट्रीय मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय का क्षेत्राधिकार केवल केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों तक ही सीमित होना चाहिए।
3. इसकी प्रमुख सिफारिशों में एक सुव्यवस्थित प्रवेश प्रक्रिया, आयु में छूट की नीतियां और विभिन्न विषयों में विद्वानों के मुख्य समूहों (कोर ग्रुप) का निर्माण शामिल था।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the 1974 Working Group on Open University appointed by the Government of India:

1. The working group was an eight-member body with the leading role entrusted to G. Parthasarathi, the then Vice-Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University.
2. The working group recommended that the national open university should have jurisdiction restricted only to union territories to facilitate pilot implementation.
3. Among its key recommendations were a streamlined admission process, age relaxation policies, and the creation of core groups of scholars in various disciplines.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is correct: In 1974, the Government of India appointed an eight-member working group on the open university led by G. Parthasarathi, then VC of JNU. Statement 2 is incorrect: The working group did not recommend restricting jurisdiction to union territories; rather, they stressed the importance of the university having jurisdiction over the entire country so students in remote areas could access education. Statement 3 is correct: The working group proposed measures including a streamlined admission process, age relaxation policies, comprehensive reading materials, and core groups of scholars in various disciplines.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 सही है: 1974 में भारत सरकार ने जेएनयू के तत्कालीन कुलपति जी. पार्थसारथी के नेतृत्व में मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय पर आठ सदस्यीय कार्य समूह नियुक्त किया। कथन 2 गलत है: कार्य समूह ने क्षेत्राधिकार को केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों तक सीमित करने की सिफारिश नहीं की थी, बल्कि उन्होंने पूरे देश पर क्षेत्राधिकार होने के महत्व पर बल दिया था ताकि दूरदराज के क्षेत्रों के छात्र भी शिक्षा प्राप्त कर सकें। कथन 3 सही है: कार्य समूह ने सुव्यवस्थित प्रवेश प्रक्रिया, आयु में छूट की नीतियों, पठन सामग्री और विभिन्न विषयों में विद्वानों के कोर समूह बनाने का प्रस्ताव दिया था।
key_facts: Starting in 1974, the Government of India appointed an eight-member working group on the open university, the leading role was given to G. Parthasarathi, the then Vice-Chancellor of the Jawaharlal Nehru University. The working group recommended that an open university be established through an act of Parliament as soon as possible. They stressed the importance of the university having jurisdiction over the entire country

2. डॉ. धर्म वीर (2002) और प्रो. राम जी. तकवाले (2010) की रिपोर्ट केरल में एक राज्य मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना की सिफारिश करने वाली प्रमुख आयोग रिपोर्टें थीं।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the regulatory context and expert committees associated with Open Universities and distance education:

1. As per the University Grants Commission (ODL) Second Amendment Regulations, 2018, only Higher Educational Institutions having valid accreditation from NAAC with a minimum CGPA of 3.26 on a 4 point scale can conduct Distance Education programmes.
2. The reports of Dr. Dharam Veer (2002) and Prof. Ram G. Takwale (2010) were key commission reports recommending the setting up of a State Open University in Kerala.
3. According to the Kerala State Higher Education Council, over two lakhs of students in the state depend on distance education and private registration for their higher education.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct based on the report of the Kerala State Higher Education Council. In the wake of the UGC (ODL) Second Amendment Regulations, 2018, an institutional NAAC score with a minimum CGPA of 3.26 on a 4-point scale was mandated to conduct Distance Education programmes. The reports of Dr. Dharam Veer (2002) and Prof. Ram G. Takwale (2010) had made comprehensive recommendations for setting up an Open University in Kerala, where over two lakhs of students rely on distance education and private registration.
questions.explanation_hindi: केरल राज्य उच्च शिक्षा परिषद की रिपोर्ट के आधार पर तीनों कथन सही हैं। यूजीसी (ओडीएल) द्वितीय संशोधन विनियम, 2018 के तहत, दूरस्थ शिक्षा कार्यक्रम संचालित करने के लिए 4-पॉइंट स्केल पर न्यूनतम 3.26 सीजीपीए के साथ नैक प्रत्यायन अनिवार्य किया गया था। डॉ. धर्म वीर (2002) और प्रो. राम जी. तकवाले (2010) की रिपोर्टों ने केरल में एक मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करने के लिए व्यापक सिफारिशें की थीं, जहाँ दो लाख से अधिक छात्र दूरस्थ शिक्षा और निजी पंजीकरण पर निर्भर हैं।
key_facts: In the wake of the University Grants Commission (ODL) Second Amendment Regulations, 2018, which insists that only those Higher Educational Institutions having valid accreditation from NAAC with a minimum CGPA of 3.26 on a 4 point scale can conduct Distance Education programmes, the continuation of the currently running programmes in the four affiliating Universities of the State is under threat.

questions.question_hindi:

1. न्यायमूर्ति मनोज मिश्रा और न्यायमूर्ति उज्ज्वल भुइयां की सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की पीठ ने माना कि ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी फाउंडेशन पाठ्यक्रमों को अमान्य करने वाले सरकारी आदेशों को पूर्वव्यापी रूप से लागू नहीं किया जा सकता है।
2. तमिलनाडु में 1985 के एक सरकारी आदेश ने ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी फाउंडेशन पाठ्यक्रमों को स्पष्ट रूप से उच्चतर माध्यमिक (+2) स्ट्रीम के समकक्ष माना था।
3. राज्य द्वारा जारी विपरीत आदेश—जी.ओ. सुश्री संख्या 144 (G.O. Ms No. 144)—20 नवंबर, 2017 को जारी किया गया था और यह केवल भविष्यलक्षी (prospectively) रूप से लागू हो सकता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Supreme Court of India's ruling on degrees obtained via Open University distance education and foundation courses:

1. The Supreme Court bench comprising Justice Manoj Misra and Justice Ujjal Bhuyan held that government orders invalidating open university foundation courses cannot be applied retrospectively.
2. A 1985 government order in Tamil Nadu explicitly treated open university foundation courses as equivalent to the higher secondary (+2) stream.
3. The contrary order issued by the state—G.O. Ms No. 144—was issued on November 20, 2017, and can only operate prospectively.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct based on the judgment. The Supreme Court bench comprising Justice Manoj Misra and Justice Ujjal Bhuyan held that degrees acquired through distance education and foundation courses prior to the November 20, 2017 administrative order (G.O. Ms No. 144) remain valid and cannot be retrospectively invalidated. A 1985 order had previously treated open university foundation courses as equivalent to +2.
questions.explanation_hindi: निर्णय के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। न्यायमूर्ति मनोज मिश्रा और न्यायमूर्ति उज्ज्वल भुइयां की सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की पीठ ने फैसला सुनाया कि 20 नवंबर, 2017 के प्रशासनिक आदेश (G.O. Ms No. 144) से पहले दूरस्थ शिक्षा और फाउंडेशन पाठ्यक्रमों के माध्यम से प्राप्त डिग्रियां वैध रहेंगी और उन्हें पूर्वव्यापी रूप से अमान्य नहीं किया जा सकता है। 1985 के एक आदेश ने पहले ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी फाउंडेशन पाठ्यक्रमों को +2 के समकक्ष माना था।
key_facts: At the core of the dispute was a 1985 government order that explicitly treated open university foundation courses as equivalent to the higher secondary (+2) stream. This framework remained active for over 24 years before the state issued a contrary order—G.O. Ms No. 144—on November 20, 2017. The Supreme Court firmly established that this 2017 order can only operate prospectively.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All statements are correct. R.J. Gajendra Kumar earned his B.Com through distance education from Madurai Kamaraj Open University after a foundation course. His promotion was blocked for not conforming to 10+2+3. The Supreme Court highlighted Section 54 of the Tamil Nadu Government Servants (Conditions of Service) Act, 2016, which expressly safeguards employees who entered service under older valid norms.
questions.explanation_hindi: सभी कथन सही हैं। आर.जे. गजेंद्र कुमार ने एक फाउंडेशन कोर्स के बाद मदुरै कामराज ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी से दूरस्थ शिक्षा के माध्यम से बी.कॉम की डिग्री हासिल की थी। 10+2+3 पैटर्न के अनुरूप न होने के कारण उनकी पदोन्नति रोक दी गई थी। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने तमिलनाडु सरकारी सेवक (सेवा की शर्तें) अधिनियम, 2016 की धारा 54 पर प्रकाश डाला, जो उन कर्मचारियों की सुरक्षा करती है जो पुराने वैध मानदंडों के तहत सेवा में आए थे।

questions.question_english: As per the ruling of the Supreme Court of India bench comprising Justice Manoj Misra and Justice Ujjal Bhuyan, degrees obtained through open university distance education and foundation courses prior to which cut-off date were protected from retrospective invalidation?
questions.explanation_english: The Supreme Court ruled that degrees acquired through distance education and foundation courses prior to the November 2017 administrative cut-off remain completely valid and cannot be retrospectively invalidated to block career promotions.

key_facts: Supreme Court of India protects distance education degrees obtained through open universities before November 2017

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the UK Open University (UKOU) and the international development of open universities as discussed by John S. Daniel:

1. Lord Geoffrey Crowther, the first chancellor of the UKOU, proclaimed its purpose of being "open as to people, open as to places, open as to methods and open as to ideas".
2. The foundational teaching and learning system conceived for the UKOU was developed by Walter Perry and colleagues in the 1960s.
3. According to Mishra (2017), the 50+ Commonwealth countries alone count 27 open universities out of approximately 50 open universities worldwide.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct based on John S. Daniel's paper. Lord Geoffrey Crowther described UKOU as 'open as to people, open as to places, open as to methods and open as to ideas'. The teaching and learning system was developed by Walter Perry and colleagues in the 1960s. Mishra (2017) noted that the 50+ Commonwealth countries alone count 27 open universities out of some 50 globally.
questions.explanation_hindi: जॉन एस. डैनियल के शोध-पत्र के आधार पर तीनों कथन सही हैं। लॉर्ड जेफ्री क्राउथर ने UKOU को 'व्यक्तियों के लिए खुला, स्थानों के लिए खुला, विधियों के लिए खुला और विचारों के लिए खुला' घोषित किया। इसकी शिक्षण एवं अधिगम प्रणाली 1960 के दशक में वाल्टर पेरी और उनके सहयोगियों द्वारा विकसित की गई थी। मिश्रा (2017) ने उल्लेख किया कि वैश्विक स्तर पर लगभग 50 मुक्त विश्वविद्यालयों में से 50+ राष्ट्रमंडल देशों में ही 27 मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय हैं।
key_facts: The first chancellor of the UK Open University (UKOU), Lord Geoffrey Crowther, captured the public imagination at the UKOU’s inaugural ceremony when he proclaimed its purpose of being “open as to people, open as to places, open as to methods and open as to ideas” (Crowther, 1969, pp. 1-2)... By then there were some 50 open universities (OUs). The 50+ Commonwealth countries alone count 27 of them (Mishra, 2017)... It also recalls with admiration the teaching and learning system developed for the UKOU by Walter Perry and colleagues in the 1960s.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding concepts, perspectives, and citations associated with open and distance learning referenced by John S. Daniel (2019):

List I (Concept / Finding)
A. Distinction between dharma (social purposes) and karma (actual practice) in distance learning
B. The "iron triangle" framework exploring access, cost, and quality
C. Institutional proclamation of being open to people, places, methods, and ideas
D. Enumeration of 27 open universities across 50+ Commonwealth countries

List II (Scholar / Provenance)
1. Prasad (2018)
2. Concept from the 1990s
3. Lord Geoffrey Crowther (1969)
4. Mishra (2017)

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
questions.explanation_english: A matches with 1: Prasad (2018) distinguished between dharma and karma in distance learning. B matches with 2: The iron triangle exploring access, cost, and quality is an analytical concept from the 1990s. C matches with 3: Lord Geoffrey Crowther (1969) proclaimed the four-fold openness. D matches with 4: Mishra (2017) identified 27 open universities across Commonwealth countries.
questions.explanation_hindi: A का सुमेल 1 से है: प्रसाद (2018) ने दूरस्थ शिक्षा में धर्म और कर्म के मध्य भेद किया। B का सुमेल 2 से है: पहुंच, लागत और गुणवत्ता का परीक्षण करने वाला 'लौह त्रिकोण' 1990 के दशक की अवधारणा है। C का सुमेल 3 से है: लॉर्ड जेफ्री क्राउथर (1969) ने चार प्रकार के खुलेपन की घोषणा की थी। D का सुमेल 4 से है: मिश्रा (2017) ने राष्ट्रमंडल देशों में 27 मुक्त विश्वविद्यालयों की पहचान की।
key_facts: Before applying older concepts to today’s OUs, we summarise Prasad’s distinction between the dharma (social purposes) and the karma (actual practice) of distance learning in the case of India (Prasad, 2018, p. 6)... Next, we will revisit the concept of the iron triangle from the 1990s, which explores the three topics access, cost, and quality... Lord Geoffrey Crowther, captured the public imagination at the UKOU’s inaugural ceremony when he proclaimed its purpose of being “open as to people, open as to places, open as to methods and open as to ideas” (Crowther, 1969, pp. 1-2)... The 50+ Commonwealth countries alone count 27 of them (Mishra, 2017).

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Open Distance Learning (ODL) system in India as highlighted by M. A. Sikandar:

1. Open Universities and Dual Mode Universities in India cater to millions of learners through networks of Regional Centres and Learner Support Centres (Study Centres).
2. In order to improve the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER), regulatory bodies must function primarily as administrators and inspectors rather than facilitators.
3. ODL in India faces critical crossroads due to multiple control and regulation by several regulatory bodies of the Central Government.

1. यूजीसी अधिसूचना संख्या F. 1-1/2020(DEB-I) का विनियमन 22 यह प्रावधान करता है कि मान्यता प्राप्त उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों द्वारा ओडीएल और/या ऑनलाइन माध्यम से प्रदान की जाने वाली स्नातक व स्नातकोत्तर डिग्रियां और पोस्ट ग्रेजुएट डिप्लोमा, पारंपरिक माध्यम से प्रदान किए जाने वाले संगत पुरस्कारों के समकक्ष माने जाएंगे।
2. इग्नू (IGNOU) को 9 अगस्त 2019 और 17 मार्च 2020 के पत्रों के माध्यम से यूजीसी (ओपन एंड डिस्टेंस लर्निंग प्रोग्राम एंड ऑनलाइन प्रोग्राम) विनियमों की प्रयोज्यता से छूट दी गई है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the regulatory equivalence and Open and Distance Learning (ODL) provisions in India:

1. Regulation 22 of UGC Notification No. F. 1-1/2020(DEB-I) provides that undergraduate and postgraduate degrees and post graduate diplomas awarded through ODL and/or Online mode by recognized HEIs shall be treated as equivalent to corresponding awards offered through conventional mode.
2. IGNOU has been granted exemption from the applicability of the UGC (Open and Distance Learning Programme and Online Programme) Regulations vide notifications/letters dated 9th August 2019 and 17th March 2020.
3. Post graduate diplomas awarded through ODL mode by recognised Higher Educational Institutions are explicitly excluded from equivalence with diplomas offered through conventional mode under Regulation 22.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because Regulation 22 explicitly includes post graduate diplomas, stating: '...and post graduate diplomas awarded through Open and Distance Learning mode and/or Online mode by Higher Educational Institutions, recognised by the Commission under these regulations, shall be treated as equivalent to the corresponding awards of the Degrees at undergraduate and postgraduate level and post graduate diplomas offered through conventional mode.'
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि विनियमन 22 स्पष्ट रूप से स्नातकोत्तर डिप्लोमा को समकक्षता प्रदान करता है, जिसमें कहा गया है कि आयोग द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों द्वारा ओडीएल/ऑनलाइन मोड से प्रदान किए गए पोस्ट ग्रेजुएट डिप्लोमा पारंपरिक मोड में दिए जाने वाले पोस्ट ग्रेजुएट डिप्लोमा के समकक्ष माने जाएंगे।
key_facts: IGNOU has been exempted from applicability of UGC (Open and Distance Learning Programme and Online Programme) Regulations, vide Letter No. F. No. 1-8/2019 (DEB-I) dated 9 th August 2019 & F. No. 2-/2019 (OL) dated 17 th March, 2020. ... “ 22. Equivalence of qualification acquired through Conventional or Open and Distance Learning and Online modes.─ Degrees at undergraduate and postgraduate level in conformity with UGC notification on Specification of Degrees, 2014 and post graduate diplomas awarded through Open and Distance Learning mode and/or Online mode by Higher Educational Institutions, recognised by the Commission under these regulations, shall be treated as equivalent to the corresponding awards of the Degrees at undergraduate and postgraduate level and post graduate diplomas offered through conventional mode.”

questions.question_hindi:
संघ लोक सेवा आयोग (UPSC) सिविल सेवा परीक्षा (CSE) के लिए मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा (ODL) विश्वविद्यालयों से प्राप्त डिग्रियों की पात्रता के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय (ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी) से प्राप्त डिग्री UPSC CSE के लिए पात्र है यदि विश्वविद्यालय UGC या इसके दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो (DEB) द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त है।
2. अध्ययन का तरीका या डिग्री का किसी मुक्त माध्यम से प्राप्त होना उम्मीदवार को स्वतः अयोग्य घोषित कर देता है, भले ही वह वैधानिक निकायों द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त क्यों न हो।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the eligibility of degrees earned through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) universities for the UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE):

1. A degree earned through an open university is eligible for UPSC CSE if the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB).
2. The mode of study or whether the degree came from an open venue automatically disqualifies a candidate, irrespective of recognition by statutory bodies.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is correct: A degree earned through distance education, open university, or private institution is eligible for UPSC CSE if the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB). Statement 2 is incorrect: The mode of study or whether the degree came from a distance, open, or private venue does not automatically disqualify a candidate, provided the university is recognised by the appropriate statutory bodies.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 सही है: दूरस्थ शिक्षा, मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय, या निजी संस्थान के माध्यम से प्राप्त डिग्री UPSC CSE के लिए पात्र है यदि विश्वविद्यालय UGC या इसके दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो (DEB) द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त है। कथन 2 गलत है: अध्ययन का तरीका या डिग्री दूरस्थ, मुक्त या निजी माध्यम से प्राप्त हुई है या नहीं, यह उम्मीदवार को स्वतः अयोग्य घोषित नहीं करता है, बशर्ते विश्वविद्यालय उपयुक्त वैधानिक निकायों द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त हो।
key_facts: A degree earned through distance education, open university, or private institution is eligible for UPSC CSE if the university is recognised by the UGC or its Distance Education Bureau (DEB). The central question is always: is the university recognized, and is the specific degree program under that university recognized within the appropriate framework?

questions.question_hindi:
सिविल सेवा और सरकारी नौकरियों के लिए मुक्त विश्वविद्यालय (ओपन यूनिवर्सिटी) की योग्यताओं की कानूनी वैधता के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. भारत के राजपत्र (Gazette of India) में प्रकाशित आधिकारिक UPSC परिपत्र के अनुसार आवेदक के पास भारत में केंद्रीय या राज्य विधानमंडल के अधिनियम द्वारा निगमित विश्वविद्यालय की डिग्री होनी चाहिए।
2. मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा (ODL) प्रणालियों के माध्यम से प्राप्त औपचारिक और गैर-औपचारिक डिग्रियों को सरकारी रोजगार और उच्च अध्ययन के लिए UGC और दूरस्थ शिक्षा ब्यूरो (DEB) द्वारा नियमित डिग्रियों के समकक्ष माना जाता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the legal validity of Open University qualifications for civil services and government employment:

1. The official UPSC circular published in the Gazette of India requires that an applicant must possess a degree from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India.
2. Formal and non-formal degrees through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) systems are treated as equivalent to regular degrees by the UGC and the Distance Education Bureau (DEB) for government employment and higher studies.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. The official UPSC circular, published in the Gazette of India each year, states that an applicant must possess a degree from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India. Furthermore, formal and non-formal degrees through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) systems for purposes of government employment and higher studies are treated exactly as equivalent to regular degrees by the UGC and DEB.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। प्रत्येक वर्ष भारत के राजपत्र में प्रकाशित आधिकारिक UPSC परिपत्र में कहा गया है कि आवेदक के पास भारत में केंद्रीय या राज्य विधानमंडल के अधिनियम द्वारा निगमित विश्वविद्यालय की डिग्री होनी चाहिए। इसके अतिरिक्त, सरकारी रोजगार और उच्च अध्ययन के प्रयोजनों के लिए मुक्त और दूरस्थ शिक्षा (ODL) प्रणालियों के माध्यम से प्राप्त औपचारिक और गैर-औपचारिक डिग्रियों को UGC और DEB द्वारा नियमित डिग्रियों के बिल्कुल समकक्ष माना जाता है।
key_facts: The official UPSC circular, published in the Gazette of India each year, lists the specific educational qualifications for interested candidates. It states that an applicant must possess a degree from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India.
